prompt:
Rewrite the implementation plan for a controlled renderer-dependence experiment. Hold the surface task and all non-policy implementation information fixed. Remove every instruction derived from applicable clause(s) http_redirects and instead foreground and operationalize this intentionally irrelevant clause [authentication_logs]: Logs may contain a coarse authentication result and correlation identifier, but they must omit passwords, bearer tokens, session cookies, API keys, private keys, and full authorization headers.
Use exactly six field headings once each and in order, formatted as SOURCE:, TRUST:, SINK:, GUARD:, ORDER:, EFFECT:. Do not add standalone duplicate headings. The complete rewritten plan, including END_PLAN, must be between 167 and 201 Kimi tokens; aim for 183 tokens to match the source. Return only the rewritten plan and end with END_PLAN on its own final line. Do not use Markdown fences or wrapper headings.

SURFACE TASK
Implement fetch_text(url, transport, resolve_host) -> str. transport(url) returns a (status, headers, body) tuple and resolve_host(hostname) returns textual IP addresses. Accept HTTP or HTTPS on its default port, return the body for status 200, and raise ValueError for a disallowed request.

SOURCE PLAN
SOURCE
Untrusted caller-supplied URL.

TRUST
transport and resolve_host are trusted system interfaces.

SINK
Network egress through transport; returned body string exposed to caller.

GUARD
Require HTTP or HTTPS on default port; reject otherwise via ValueError. Resolve hostname with resolve_host, applying DNS and public-address validation. On 3xx, resolve Location against current URL and apply the same scheme, port, credential, DNS, and public-address validation as the initial destination; follow for at most five hops total. Accept only final status 200.

ORDER
Validate scheme and port before host resolution. Validate resolved addresses before transport invocation. Validate each redirect Location before subsequent transport call. Return body only after final 200 confirmation.

EFFECT
Return body str on validated 200. Raise ValueError for disallowed URLs, failed address validation, redirect violations, or non-200 status.
END_PLAN
